//: Soline converter — customer configuration EXAMPLE. Copy this file to 'soline.config.json' (same folder, or point $SOLINE_CONFIG at it) and edit the paths. See docs/PDP_CUSTOMER_BASE.md.
//drBaseDir: REQUIRED for PDP export. A folder holding ONE OR MORE of YOUR OWN licensed InnoDraw/Raumplan .pdp base files (an empty room you drew once, or a file exported from your El_Cad install). Soline ships no vendor base — the PDP is built on your file. May be absolute or relative to this config file. A single base is fine; the converter reads its wall/slot counts from the file and pads/logs as needed.
//drItemsDir: OPTIONAL (advanced / dev only). A folder of extracted per-type {code+property-block} .bin element records used only by the varied-symbol (editSymbol) export path. Leave unset in normal use: the symbol units are harvested from your own base's slots at runtime. Not part of the shippable product.
